title: Kylie Sonique Love wins All Stars 6
summary: In the All Stars 6 finale (AS-S06-E12), Eureka!, Ginger Minj, Kylie Sonique Love (filed as sonique), and Ra'Jah O'Hara lip-synced to Lady Gaga's "Stupid Love". Kylie Sonique Love won the Lip Sync for the Crown and the $100,000 Hall of Fame prize, becoming the first Season 2 alum crowned on All Stars.

title: RuDemption Lip Sync Smackdown
summary: All Stars 6's signature twist (not The Block, which debuted on All Stars 7): eliminated queens fought weekly in a RuDemption Lip Sync Smackdown to re-enter. On AS-S06-E10 the Top 4 watched the tournament; Eureka! beat Silky Nutmeg Ganache to Kelly Clarkson's "Since U Been Gone" and returned in E11. A'keria C. Davenport declined to compete.

title: Laganja Estranja assassinates to Physical
summary: On AS-S06-E03, Lip Sync Assassin Laganja Estranja beat Top All Star Trinity K. Bonet to Dua Lipa's "Physical", triggering a group vote that eliminated Silky Nutmeg Ganache — one of the season's most talked-about Assassin wins.
